doc.brief: A `GtkShortcutsSection` collects all the keyboard shortcuts and gestures for a major application mode.
doc.deprecated_md: This widget will be removed in GTK 5
doc.md:
A `GtkShortcutsSection` collects all the keyboard shortcuts and gestures
for a major application mode.

If your application needs multiple sections, you should give each
section a unique [`ShortcutsSection:section-name`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ShortcutsSection#property:section-name) and
a [`ShortcutsSection:title`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ShortcutsSection#property:title) that can be shown in the
section selector of the [`ShortcutsWindow`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ShortcutsWindow).

The [`ShortcutsSection:max-height`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ShortcutsSection#property:max-height) property can be used
to influence how the groups in the section are distributed over pages
and columns.

This widget is only meant to be used with [`ShortcutsWindow`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ShortcutsWindow).

The recommended way to construct a `GtkShortcutsSection` is with
[`Builder`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Builder), by using the `<child>` tag to populate a
`GtkShortcutsSection` with one or more [`ShortcutsGroup`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ShortcutsGroup)
instances, which in turn contain one or more [`ShortcutsShortcut`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ShortcutsShortcut)
objects.

If you need to add a group programmatically, use
[`ShortcutsSection.add_group()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ShortcutsSection#method:add_group).

# Shortcuts and Gestures

Pan gestures allow to navigate between sections.

The following signals have default keybindings:

- [`ShortcutsSection::change-current-page`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ShortcutsSection#event:change-current-page)

add_group.brief: Adds a group to the shortcuts section.
add_group.deprecated_md: This widget will be removed in GTK 5
add_group.md:
Adds a group to the shortcuts section.

This is the programmatic equivalent to using [`Builder`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Builder) and a
`<child>` tag to add the child.

Adding children with the `GtkBox` API is not appropriate, as
`GtkShortcutsSection` manages its children internally.

max-height.brief: The maximum number of lines to allow per column.
max-height.deprecated_md: This widget will be removed in GTK 5
max-height.md:
The maximum number of lines to allow per column.

This property can be used to influence how the groups in this
section are distributed across pages and columns. The default
value of 15 should work in most cases.

section-name.brief: A unique name to identify this section among the sections added to the `GtkShortcutsWindow`.
section-name.deprecated_md: This widget will be removed in GTK 5
section-name.md:
A unique name to identify this section among the sections
added to the `GtkShortcutsWindow`.

Setting the [`ShortcutsWindow:section-name`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ShortcutsWindow#property:section-name) property
to this string will make this section shown in the `GtkShortcutsWindow`.

title.brief: The string to show in the section selector of the `GtkShortcutsWindow` for this section.
title.deprecated_md: This widget will be removed in GTK 5
title.md:
The string to show in the section selector of the `GtkShortcutsWindow`
for this section.

If there is only one section, you don't need to set a title,
since the section selector will not be shown in this case.

view-name.brief: A view name to filter the groups in this section by.
view-name.deprecated_md: This widget will be removed in GTK 5
view-name.md:
A view name to filter the groups in this section by.

See [`ShortcutsGroup:view`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ShortcutsGroup#property:view).

Applications are expected to use the
[`ShortcutsWindow:view-name`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ShortcutsWindow#property:view-name) property
for this purpose.

change-current-page.brief: Emitted when we change the current page.
change-current-page.deprecated_md: This widget will be removed in GTK 5
change-current-page.md:
Emitted when we change the current page.

The default bindings for this signal are
<kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>PgUp</kbd>, <kbd>PgUp</kbd>,
<kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>PgDn</kbd>, <kbd>PgDn</kbd>.
